english.title: Knowingly / recklessly give false/misleading notice / certificate under Building Act 1984
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) gave a

(A)_[notice]_
(B)_[certificate]_

that purported to comply with

(C)_[Part II of]_
(D)_[section 16(9) of]_
(E)_[building regulations falling within paragraph 4A(1)(a) of Schedule 1 to]_
(F)_[building regulations falling within paragraph 4A(1)(b) of Schedule 1 to]_

the Building Act 1984 and contained a statement that you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular or recklessly gave such a

(G)_[notice]_
(H)_[certificate]_

which was false or misleading in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 57(1)(a) of the Building Act 1984.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
